vulnerability.explanation: The 'state' index parsed from the input is used to read 'states[state]' without bounds checking. If 'state' >= 1000, 'if (states[state] == NULL)' reads past the end of the 'states' array. If this out-of-bounds location happens to be non-NULL, the subsequent call 'xmlAutomataSetFinalState(am, states[state])' will pass an invalid pointer, compounding the error. Reachable via 'f ' lines in the input file.
